responsibility: Verifies Apple-specific target-version helpers by testing deployment-version parsing and insertion of deployment versions into LLVM target triples.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `tests.rs` files, this one stays within `back::apple` and checks Apple deployment-version handling on LLVM target triples (`parse_version`, `add_version_to_llvm_target`), not linker-argument rewriting or general rpath computation.
